title: Dispute the 2025 T1 reassessment that added the cancelled Lazer T4A ($39,118.81)
detail: CRA reassessed 2025 (notice dated 2 November 2026) adding $82,791 of T4A income from 2621956 ONTARIO INC., almost certainly Lazer's payer account; Lazer cancelled that slip on 22 April 2026 (submission 31778159) but CRA never acted on it. On CRA's advice Lazer filed an amended slip instead on 23 October 2026 (submission 32114692): SIN box 012 blank, box 013 the corporation's BN ending 958RC0001, corporation's address, box 048 still $82,791.46, and the recipient name still reads Umar; Umar decided on 28 October 2026 not to have it changed, since the blank SIN and the BN are what keep the slip off the T1. Saira is already authorized in My Account (confirmed 28 October 2026); she files the notice of objection by 20 January 2027 (ideally before the 23 November due date so collection is held), attaching the amended slip, the cancelled slip and the amended summaries, with a note that the fees were paid to 15248132 Canada Inc. and reported on its T2 2025. Watch My Account tax slips for the Lazer T4A to drop off. Do not pay the T4A part or use Change my return; the $65.08 instalment interest is separate and likely stands; the spouse amount change comes from the T4A and reverses with it. The $22,130.37 refund was paid, per the notice. Saira called CRA on 27 October 2026: the agent said the balance only clears once CRA processes amended slip 32114692, typically about six months (around April 2027); file the objection anyway so collection is held past 23 November.
